name: ephpm/cache
description: PSR-16 (SimpleCache) and PSR-6 cache implementations backed by ePHPm's embedded, cluster-replicated KV store via the global ephpm_kv_* SAPI functions.

ephpm.comment: stubs/ephpm-kv.stub.php is an IDE/static-analysis stub ONLY. It is intentionally NOT listed in autoload.files: at runtime the global ephpm_kv_* functions are provided natively by the ePHPm engine, and autoloading the stub would redefine them and fatal. Point your analyzer (PhpStorm, Psalm, PHPStan) at the stubs/ directory instead.
